text: amazing, hey so whats the damage to get all of these into a system that is less..... autistic. like all the categories here mean literally nothing and shit is so scattered that it is more a pain than anything else. literally anything is better than this abc family naming
resolution: Reworked the visible hmsc-int material catalog taxonomy so shader recipes are grouped by semantic authoring shelves rather than effect-board letters. The catalog now uses shelves such as Pavement & Streets, Wallpaper & Interior Walls, Metal & Industrial, Glass/Light/Gradients, and Codes & Stencils; the shared chooser fallback no longer emits a-family or misc, so buildings, clothing, vehicles, and FacePainter stop leaking ABC family naming when group metadata is missing. Added/updated tests to guard the semantic grouping contract and verified the hmsc-int bundle.
